newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela/Japan Comsigua iron plant to open mid-98.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela/Japan Comsigua iron plant to open mid-98.

text.p: Production at Venezuela's hot briquetted iron Comsigua plant will begin in August 1998, Comsigua president Angel Barreto said.
"Our first contract orders are already in for December 20, 1998," Barreto told reporters.
The plant is being built by Japan's Kobe Steel, which will also manage it. Production is projected at one million tonnes per year of hot briquetted iron.

Financing will be provided by a direct equity injection of $115 million from the partners, including CVG. A further $162.3 million is available in syndicated loans backed by the U.S. Eximbank and the International Finance Corp, Baretto added.
Barreto said the project offered a 14 percent rate of return, and would bring in some $8 million annually to Venezuela in income taxes.
Eighty percent of exports have been earmarked for the United States with the remainder split between Mexico and South Korea.
